placement_notes: The package's own README says the V21 layers are NOT the latest montage (the montage was one flattened generated image with no recoverable layers). The layers differ in silhouette from the montage, so a mask-overlap fit scored 0.30-0.47 and was rejected; placement uses the window rule measured on the approved fronts (subject stands on the art window floor, row 329 of 630, max 233 tall x 310 wide, centred). Tall overlays are card-sized and used as-is. Back previews: each supplied tall PNG is transformed as ONE whole image (a single affine map: rotate + uniform resize + move; nothing cropped, split or recoloured). Rotation makes the plant's principal axis vertical; scale fits 108x222 reference px; centred on x=195, standing on row 429; #71 needed +8 deg clockwise by eye. Render with: --align-tall --tall-extra-cw 71=8.
